artes.prompt: Recreate the attached logo as a clean, crisp, professional company logo, faithful to the attachment. Wordmark "MECT" in a heavy geometric sans-serif, all caps, tight letter spacing, royal blue (#1560E8). Below the left part of the word, a thin wave/swoosh stroke in the same blue that starts thin at the left, dips and ends where the word "Tecnologia" begins. "Tecnologia" in a bold geometric sans-serif, smaller, darker blue (#0C3FA8), aligned under the right half of MECT, exactly like the attachment. Flat design: no gradient, no shadow, no 3D, no outline, no icon, no other text, no mockup, no watermark. Logo centered, large, on a pure flat white background (#FFFFFF), generous margins. Spell exactly: MECT and Tecnologia.

Photorealistic, high-resolution corporate photo. Use the 2nd attachment as the composition reference: a modern silver laptop on a light wooden office desk, three-quarter view from the front-left, screen facing the viewer, a small green potted plant behind it on the left, a dark blue ceramic coffee mug on the right, a closed notebook with a pen in the front right corner, a bright modern office with large windows softly blurred in the background (shallow depth of field), daylight, clean and airy, cool blue and white tones. On the mug, print the logo from the 1st attachment in white, small and exactly as in the attachment (MECT with the wave and the word Tecnologia). On the laptop screen, a clean light-themed web dashboard for hospital quality management: left sidebar with the QualiGuide logo from the 3rd attachment at the top, a greeting headline, three soft colored KPI cards (blue, green, peach), a green bar chart and a green/orange donut chart. Keep the screen UI simple and legible; do not invent other brand names. The left 20% of the image should be calm (desk and plant, no important objects) because the photo is cropped with a curve on the left. No people, no watermark, no extra text.

Clean product render: a modern silver laptop seen in three-quarter perspective from the left, floating with a soft shadow, on a pure flat very light blue background (#EEF4FF) that fades to white, like the 2nd attachment. On the screen, a light-themed web dashboard for hospital quality management: white left sidebar with the QualiGuide logo from the 1st attachment at the top and menu items, a headline greeting, three soft KPI cards (light blue, light green, light peach), a green bar chart and a green/orange donut chart, gray placeholder text lines. Crisp, high resolution, centered, the laptop fills about 80% of the width. No other objects, no text outside the screen, no watermark.
